name: Luminance Compound
description: Chem master Alden needs rare ingredients to synthesize a high-grade luminance compound. Assist him and unlock the formula.

text: Seeker, I need assistance synthesizing a luminance compound.
Can you fetch Moonshade Herb for me?
completedText: Seek out the elusive Moonshade Herb.
Return to Alden with the herbs.

hasItemText: You've done it. Watch as I synthesize the compound.
I'll upload the formula to your records.

popup.title: Quest completed!
popup.text: @green@You've unlocked the @crimson@Luminance Compound Recipe@green@ and gained @crimson@3200 Alchemy experience@green@.
